```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css" />
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/papaparse@5.4.1/papaparse.min.js"></script>

<div style="background:#fff3cd;border:1px solid #ffeeba;border-radius:4px;padding:0.5rem 1rem;margin-bottom:1rem;font-size:0.9rem;">
  <strong>Test section</strong> — provincial panel of Italian emigration by destination and occupational sector,
  1876–1913, from Gentili (2026), <a href="https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23478963">doi:10.5281/zenodo.23478963</a>.
  <a href="migration.html">Emigration 1911–1921 (Annuario)</a> · <a href="index.html">← back to test home</a>
</div>

<div class="slider-container">
  <label for="yearSlider" class="year-label">Year: <span id="yearDisplay">—</span></label><br>
  <input type="range" id="yearSlider" min="0" max="0" step="1" value="0" style="width:60%;max-width:500px;">
  <div id="yearTicks" style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;max-width:500px;margin:0 auto;"></div>
</div>

<div style="text-align:center;margin:1rem 0;">
  <label for="indSelect" style="font-weight:bold;">Indicator: </label>
  <select id="indSelect" style="padding:4px 8px;font-size:1rem;"></select>
</div>

<div style="display:flex;gap:1.5rem;align-items:flex-start;">
  <div style="flex:0 0 38%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.75rem;">
    <div id="map" style="width:100%;height:560px;"></div>
    <div id="legendWrapper">
      <div class="legend-header">
        <span class="legend-title">Legend</span>
        <button id="legendToggle" type="button">Hide</button>
      </div>
      <div id="legendContent" class="map-legend"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="provinceInfo" style="flex:0 0 59%;padding:1rem;background:#f8f9fa;border-radius:4px;display:none;max-height:760px;overflow-y:auto;">
    <h4 id="provName" style="margin-top:0;"></h4>
    <table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:0.9rem;">
      <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><td style="padding:3px 4px;">Emigrants (all destinations)</td><td id="provCount" style="text-align:right;padding:3px 4px;font-weight:bold;"></td></tr>
      <tr><td style="padding:3px 4px;">Rate (per 1,000 inhabitants)</td><td id="provRate" style="text-align:right;padding:3px 4px;font-weight:bold;"></td></tr>
    </table>
    <h5 style="margin-top:1rem;margin-bottom:0.5rem;" id="seriesTitle"></h5>
    <div style="height:220px;"><canvas id="seriesChart"></canvas></div>
    <h5 style="margin-top:1rem;margin-bottom:0.5rem;">Destinations, <span class="yr"></span></h5>
    <div id="destChartBox" style="height:300px;"><canvas id="destChart"></canvas></div>
    <h5 style="margin-top:1rem;margin-bottom:0.5rem;">Occupational sectors, <span class="yr"></span></h5>
    <div id="occChartBox" style="height:260px;"><canvas id="occChart"></canvas></div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
const DATA_URL = '../data/migration/gentili/gentili_panel.csv';
const GEO_URL = '../data/geojson/province_1901.geojson';
const COLORS = ['#f7fcf5','#e5f5e0','#c7e9c0','#a1d99b','#74c476','#41ab5d','#238b45','#005a32'];
const LINE_COLOR = '#238b45', HOVER_COLOR = '#14532d';
const BASE_FIELDS = [['emig_rate', 'Emigration rate (per 1,000 inhabitants)'],
                     ['emigrants', 'Total emigrants']];

const map = L.map('map', {zoomControl:false, attributionControl:false, dragging:false,
  scrollWheelZoom:false, doubleClickZoom:false, boxZoom:false, keyboard:false,
  touchZoom:false}).setView([41.5, 12.5], 6);

let rows = [], panel = {}, YEARS = [], destCols = [], occCols = [];
let geojson = null, currentLayer = null, currentBreaks = null;
let seriesChart = null, destChart = null, occChart = null, selCod = null;

const fmt = n => (n == null || n === '') ? 'N/A' : Number(n).toLocaleString('en-US');
const pretty = c => c.replace(/^(Dest|Occ)_/, '').replace(/_/g, ' ');
const getYear = () => YEARS[document.getElementById('yearSlider').value];
const getField = () => document.getElementById('indSelect').value;
const valueOf = (rec, f) => (rec && rec[f] != null && rec[f] !== '') ? rec[f] : null;

function fillIndicators() {
  const sel = document.getElementById('indSelect');
  const group = (label, items) => '<optgroup label="' + label + '">' +
    items.map(([v, t]) => '<option value="' + v + '">' + t + '</option>').join('') + '</optgroup>';
  sel.innerHTML = group('Totals', BASE_FIELDS) +
    group('Emigrants by destination', destCols.map(c => [c, pretty(c)])) +
    group('Emigrants by occupational sector', occCols.map(c => [c, pretty(c)]));
}

async function init() {
  const [text, gj] = await Promise.all([fetch(DATA_URL).then(r => r.text()),
                                        fetch(GEO_URL).then(r => r.json())]);
  geojson = gj;
  const parsed = Papa.parse(text, {header:true, skipEmptyLines:true, dynamicTyping:true});
  rows = parsed.data;
  destCols = parsed.meta.fields.filter(c => c.startsWith('Dest_'));
  occCols = parsed.meta.fields.filter(c => c.startsWith('Occ_'));
  rows.forEach(r => { (panel[r.year] = panel[r.year] || {})[r.COD_PROV] = r; });
  YEARS = Object.keys(panel).map(Number).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const slider = document.getElementById('yearSlider');
  slider.max = YEARS.length - 1;
  slider.value = YEARS.length - 1;
  document.getElementById('yearTicks').innerHTML = YEARS.map((y, i) =>
    '<span>' + (i % 5 === 0 || i === YEARS.length - 1 ? y : '') + '</span>').join('');
  fillIndicators();
  slider.addEventListener('input', updateMap);
  document.getElementById('indSelect').addEventListener('change', updateMap);
  updateMap();
}

// Breaks are fixed across years (pooled quantiles) so colours are comparable over time.
function computeBreaks() {
  const f = getField();
  const values = rows.map(r => valueOf(r, f)).filter(v => v != null && v > 0).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  if (!values.length) return [0, 1];
  const breaks = [];
  for (let i = 1; i <= 7; i++) breaks.push(values[Math.min(Math.floor(values.length * i / 8), values.length - 1)]);
  return [...new Set(breaks)].sort((a, b) => a - b);
}

function getColor(v, breaks) {
  if (v == null) return '#e5e7eb';
  for (let i = breaks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (v > breaks[i]) return COLORS[Math.min(i + 1, COLORS.length - 1)];
  return COLORS[0];
}

function style(feature) {
  const v = valueOf((panel[getYear()] || {})[feature.properties.COD_PROV], getField());
  return {fillColor: getColor(v, currentBreaks), weight: 0.8, opacity: 1, color: '#94a3b8', fillOpacity: 0.85};
}

function barChart(old, id, cols, rec) {
  if (old) old.destroy();
  const items = cols.map(c => [pretty(c), valueOf(rec, c)]).filter(([, v]) => v != null && v > 0)
    .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 12);
  return new Chart(document.getElementById(id).getContext('2d'), {
    type: 'bar',
    data: {labels: items.map(i => i[0]),
           datasets: [{data: items.map(i => i[1]), backgroundColor: LINE_COLOR}]},
    options: {indexAxis: 'y', responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false,
      plugins: {legend: {display: false}}, scales: {x: {beginAtZero: true}}}
  });
}

function showProvince(cod) {
  selCod = cod;
  const year = getYear(), rec = (panel[year] || {})[cod];
  const f = getField();
  const label = document.getElementById('indSelect').selectedOptions[0].text;
  const name = rec ? rec.Province : '';
  document.getElementById('provinceInfo').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('provName').textContent = name + ' (' + year + ')';
  document.getElementById('provCount').textContent = fmt(valueOf(rec, 'emigrants'));
  document.getElementById('provRate').textContent = fmt(valueOf(rec, 'emig_rate'));
  document.getElementById('seriesTitle').textContent = label + ' over time';
  document.querySelectorAll('.yr').forEach(e => e.textContent = year);
  const data = YEARS.map(y => ({x: y, y: valueOf((panel[y] || {})[cod], f)})).filter(d => d.y != null);
  if (seriesChart) seriesChart.destroy();
  seriesChart = new Chart(document.getElementById('seriesChart').getContext('2d'), {
    type: 'line',
    data: {datasets: [{data: data, borderColor: LINE_COLOR, backgroundColor: LINE_COLOR, pointRadius: 2, borderWidth: 1.5}]},
    options: {responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: {legend: {display: false}},
      scales: {x: {type: 'linear', ticks: {callback: v => v}}, y: {beginAtZero: true}}}
  });
  destChart = barChart(destChart, 'destChart', destCols, rec);
  occChart = barChart(occChart, 'occChart', occCols, rec);
}

function onEachFeature(feature, layer) {
  layer.on({
    mouseover: e => { e.target.setStyle({weight: 2, color: HOVER_COLOR, fillOpacity: 1}); e.target.bringToFront(); },
    mouseout: e => { if (currentLayer) currentLayer.resetStyle(e.target); },
    click: () => showProvince(feature.properties.COD_PROV)
  });
}

function updateMap() {
  document.getElementById('yearDisplay').textContent = getYear();
  currentBreaks = computeBreaks();
  if (currentLayer) map.removeLayer(currentLayer);
  currentLayer = L.geoJSON(geojson, {style: style, onEachFeature: onEachFeature}).addTo(map);
  map.fitBounds(currentLayer.getBounds(), {padding: [10, 10]});
  updateLegend();
  if (selCod != null) showProvince(selCod);
}

document.getElementById('legendToggle').addEventListener('click', function() {
  const hidden = document.getElementById('legendWrapper').classList.toggle('legend-hidden');
  this.textContent = hidden ? 'Show' : 'Hide';
});

function updateLegend() {
  const div = document.getElementById('legendContent');
  const label = document.getElementById('indSelect').selectedOptions[0].text;
  let html = '<strong>' + label + '</strong>';
  html += '<div class="legend-row"><i style="background:' + COLORS[0] + '"></i><span>&lt; ' + fmt(currentBreaks[0]) + '</span></div>';
  currentBreaks.forEach((b, i) => {
    const next = currentBreaks[i + 1], clr = COLORS[Math.min(i + 1, COLORS.length - 1)];
    html += '<div class="legend-row"><i style="background:' + clr + '"></i><span>' +
      (next ? fmt(b) + '–' + fmt(next) : '&gt; ' + fmt(b)) + '</span></div>';
  });
  html += '<div class="legend-row"><i style="background:#e5e7eb"></i><span>no data</span></div>';
  div.innerHTML = html;
}

init();
</script>

<div style="margin-top:2rem;padding-top:1rem;border-top:1px solid #ddd;font-size:0.9rem;color:#555;">
<p><strong>Source and citation.</strong> Data: Gentili, A. (2026). <em>A provincial panel dataset of Italian
historical mass migration by foreign destination and occupational sector (1876–1913)</em> (Version v2) [Data set].
Zenodo. <a href="https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23478963">https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23478963</a>.
Licensed under <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>. The dataset was hand-digitised
from the <em>Statistica della emigrazione italiana all'estero</em> (Ministero di Agricoltura, Industria e Commercio):
69 post-Unification provinces, 1876–1913, 54 variables. Missing provincial destination data were filled by the author
with intertemporal linear interpolation (see the Zenodo record).</p>
<p><strong>Processing by DEMOPAST.</strong> Province names were matched to the 1901 boundaries (COD_PROV).
<em>Total emigrants</em> is male + female emigrants. In the source file the column <code>Total_Emigration</code> holds
the full total up to 1903 (where it equals male + female in every province-year) but only a small partial figure from
1904 on, so the sex-specific columns are used; their national sum matches the official totals (e.g. 1913: 872,596).
Where no sex breakdown exists (1876–1883) the total is used; totals are missing for 1888, 1890 and 1892.
<em>Rate</em> = emigrants / population × 1,000, with province population (sum of the age groups of the DEMOPAST
censuses of 1871, 1881, 1901, 1911, 1921) linearly interpolated between censuses. Province 14 is absent from the
1881 census and is interpolated between 1871 and 1901. Boundaries are held fixed at the 69 provinces of the dataset.
Colour breaks are pooled over all years so shades are comparable across the slider.</p>
<p><strong>Download:</strong> <a href="../data/migration/gentili/Italian_Migration_1876_1913_English_Panel.csv" download>original CSV (Zenodo, unmodified)</a> ·
<a href="../data/migration/gentili/gentili_panel.csv" download>gentili_panel.csv</a> (with COD_PROV, interpolated population and rate)</p>
<p>Preliminary — test environment.</p>
</div>
```
